author: Guerrilla Miniature Games
description:
We're back with The Indie Hour Episode Sixty-Three! This series focuses on games you may have never even heard of and gives us an inside look at the wider world of independantly published Tabletop Wargames of all genres.

The Apocalypse Universe has a new small warband Skirmish edition ready to play from Apocalypse Games. Grab a team of five cool 'tropey' Apocalypse models in this narrative skirmish game inspired by OG table-generator systems like Rogue Trader. Let's check it out!

Check out the rules HERE: https://www.wargamevault.com/en/product/539663/raid-2nd-edition?affiliate_id=210041
title: The GMG Indie Hour Ep 064 - RAID: WWApocalypse by Apocalypse Games
